purpose: A lightweight, noninteractive trend graphic inside a dense table cell.
behaviorProvider: Shared data-grid cell adapter; table/record state remains with its host.

component: Forward data, variant, intent, dimensions, label and className directly to Sparkline. Preserve the shared primitive data handling, SVG sizing and accessible summary.
host: Provide a meaningful trend label and constrain the containing table column. Supply finite observations with a documented time/order meaning.
Use the canonical Sparkline behavior contract for geometry and empty-state rules rather than reimplementing SVG calculations.

requirements.statement: Forward data, variant, intent, dimensions, label and className directly to Sparkline. Preserve the shared primitive data handling, SVG sizing and accessible summary.
Provide a meaningful trend label and constrain the containing table column. Supply finite observations with a documented time/order meaning.
Use the canonical Sparkline behavior contract for geometry and empty-state rules rather than reimplementing SVG calculations.

Use data-display group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: The adapter adds no axes, tooltips, aggregation or live data service.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
